text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. `.sdlc/runs/20261104-docs-catalog-model-tsdoc/requirements.md` has been written with:

- **In scope / Out of scope**: Numbered items covering the 45 `(undocumented)` markers in `packages/catalog-model/report.api.md`, regenerated API reports, and `.changeset/catalog-model-tsdoc.md`, while excluding alpha-only markers, nested `spec` fields, `README.md`, `/docs`, and off-limits files.
- **Functional requirements (`FR-1` to `FR-16`)**: One requirement per file in scope (the 15 TypeScript source files plus `.changeset/catalog-model-tsdoc.md`), detailing every export/member and its exact implementation-verified behavior.
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1` to `NFR-6`)**: Comments-only changes, preserving release tags and copyright years, matching `@backstage/catalog-model` TSDoc style, Prettier formatting on changed files only, `yarn build:api-reports` regeneration rule, and adopter-facing changeset conventions.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Explicitly documented as `None` and `Not applicable`.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1` to `AC-6`)**: Executable checks including the verbatim `yarn build:api-reports && ! grep -q "(undocumented)" packages/catalog-model/report.api.md` command and `git status --porcelain` allowlist verification.
- **Open questions for HITL**: None.
